description: WITHDRAWN. Superseded by ledger-0005. The whole ledger is a function of the git-log file plus SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH, so two builds of one history agree byte for byte. First-parent chain oldest first: a root commit (kind commit), a merge carrying the Channel-Auto trailer of the auto lane (kind merge, mode auto — derived from the trailer, never from forge metadata), a v-tagged commit (kind release), then exactly one trailing build entry whose ts is SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH, ref the content tree hash and actor the process actor. Genesis prev is 64 zeros; actor comes from Signed-off-by normalized to human:<id>. No proposal, review or refresh entry exists at 1.0.
reason: Withdrawn at 1.0.0-rc.6 (2026-09-24). The git-log sample carried a real person's name and address where a fictitious contributor serves the case equally; a released vector is never edited in place (AGSC-00-16), so the case is republished as ledger-0005 with `Ada Example <ada@example.org>`, whose actors and hashes follow from the same rules.
